items.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued November 18 at 1:09PM AKST until November 19 at 3:00AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels of 4 to 6 feet above the normal high tide
expected for Hooper Bay. Elsewhere will see water levels of 2 to
4 feet above the normal high tide. Winds could gust as high as
50 mph.

* WHERE...Yukon Delta Coast.

* WHEN...Until 3 AM AKST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Moderate coastal flooding is possible for Hooper Bay.
Roads may be closed with airstrip access and use limited. Low
lying property including homes, businesses, and some critical
infrastructure may be inundated.
items.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.

items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 18 at 1:09PM AKST until November 19 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels of 3 to 5 feet above the normal high tide
expected. Winds could gust as high as 50 mph.

* WHERE...Southern Seward Peninsula Coast.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM AKST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Minor coastal flooding is possible. In Nome, water
could approach homes in the Belmont Subdivision, portions of the
port area will have standing water, and wave run-up will push
water higher than normal. In Golovin, water will approach beach
property.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 18 at 12:52PM AKST until November 21 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 18 at 11:14AM AKST until November 18 at 9:00PM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts of 50 to 60 mph with

* WHERE...Anchorage Hillside and Eagle River Hillside.

* WHEN...Until 9 PM AKST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outages may result.
items.instruction:

profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued November 17 at 1:32PM AKST until November 19 at 6:00PM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Small stream and localized urban flooding caused by
excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...Including the following area, Southern Kenai Mtns. This
includes the city of Seward.

* WHEN...From Wednesday morning through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Storm drains and ditches may become clogged with debris. Flooding
may occur in poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS.
items.instruction:

television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.
